title: Fix comment list creation stuck in loading state

requirements.text: Fix the backend createCommentList method in backend/main.mo to properly persist new comment lists and return success confirmation

quotes: List creation gets stuck in 'Creating List...' loading state and never completes
Lists should be stored in the Motoko backend canister so all users can access them

acceptanceCriteria: The createCommentList method successfully stores new lists in stable storage
The method returns a proper success response that the frontend can handle
All users can access newly created lists from the backend

requirements.text: Fix the frontend async handling in useAdminComments.ts and AdminCommentsTab.tsx to properly await the backend response when creating a new comment list

quotes: The 'Creating List...' button is stuck in loading state when you try to create the 'Story tv' comment list
Fix the frontend async handling so the creation actually completes and the UI updates properly

acceptanceCriteria: The loading state ('Creating List...') resolves after backend responds
Success or error feedback is displayed to the user
The input field is cleared after successful creation

requirements.text: Update the 'Manage Existing Lists' dropdown to automatically refresh and display newly created comment lists after successful creation

quotes: After successful creation, the new list should appear in the dropdown under 'Manage Existing Lists'

acceptanceCriteria: Newly created lists immediately appear in the 'Select List' dropdown
The dropdown updates from 'No lists available - create one above' to show the new list
The dropdown correctly populates with the list name that was just created (e.g., 'Story tv')

requirements.text: Add proper error handling and user feedback for comment list creation failures

quotes: Add proper error handling and user feedback
Proper feedback if something goes wrong

acceptanceCriteria: Display clear error messages if list creation fails
The loading state exits properly even on error
User can retry creation after an error

constraints: Keep all Motoko logic in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui/*
Maintain the existing single-actor backend architecture
Preserve the current React Query pattern for cache invalidation
nonGoals: Adding authentication requirements for list creation
Implementing list editing or renaming features
Adding permissions or access control to comment lists
Changing the UI design or styling of the list creation interface
